e:
From Japanese 子供 (kodomo, “child”) + -con, modeled after lolicon and similar compounds.
Notably, English kodomo is primarily used to refer to children's anime and manga, while Japanese コドコン (kodokon) is uncommon.
Respelled to reflect the /ə/ in the pronunciation, possibly under the influence of shotacon.
Borrowed from Japanese 小太刀 (kodachi, literally “small tachi”).
